answer: Each challenge is instantiated only after a specified future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature supplies publicly verifiable, unpredictable entropy. The task binds that pulse to a nonce, agent identity, and domain-separated hash; a short response window and commit-reveal checks reject replayed work. Thus saffron, mirror, and karst task variants cannot be farmed offline in advance, while identity-linked costs make spawning sybils costly.
